026/**
027 * A Swing component that renders a grid of {@link Square} objects and provides
028 * extensive interactivity including selection, shading, numeric labels, and
029 * contextual information popups.
030 *
031 * <p>This panel is designed for integration with the PAINT Viewer and is used
032 * to display region-level quantitative metrics overlaid on a TrackMate or
033 * Brightfield image. Each square corresponds to a fixed spatial region whose
034 * properties can be visualized, filtered, or interactively selected.</p>
035 *
036 * <p>Features include:</p>
037 * <ul>
038 *   <li>Drag or click-based selection of visible squares.</li>
039 *   <li>Visibility filtering based on density ratio, variability, R², and neighbour mode.</li>
040 *   <li>Deterministic color shading based on assigned cell IDs.</li>
041 *   <li>Configurable numeric display modes (none, label, square number).</li>
042 *   <li>Contextual statistical popups for detailed inspection.</li>
043 * </ul>
044 *
045 * <p>Rendering is resolution-adaptive and automatically scales to the component's
046 * current size. Interaction can be selectively enabled or disabled by calling
047 * {@link #setInteractionEnabled(boolean)} or {@link #setSelectionEnabled(boolean)}.</p>
048 */
049public class SquareGridPanel extends JPanel {
050
051    private final int          rows;
052    private final int          cols;
053
054    private       Image        backgroundImage;
055    private       List<Square> squares                 = new ArrayList<>();
056    private final Set<Integer> selectedSquaresNumbers  = new HashSet<>();
057
058    private       boolean      showBorders             = true;
059    private       boolean      showShading             = true;
060    private       Rectangle    selectionRect           = null;
061    private       Point        dragStart               = null;
062
063    private       double       minRequiredDensityRatio = 0.0;
064    private       double       maxAllowableVariability = Double.MAX_VALUE;
065    private       double       minRequiredRSquared     = 0.0;
066    private       String       neighbourMode           = "Free";
067    private       boolean      selectionEnabled        = false;
068    private final Set<Integer> dragSelectedSquares     = new HashSet<>();
069    private       boolean      interactionEnabled      = true;
070    private       boolean      infoPopupsEnabled       = true;
071
072
073    /**
074     * Enumeration defining numeric display modes for squares.
075     * <ul>
076     *   <li>{@code NONE}: No numbers are displayed.</li>
077     *   <li>{@code LABEL}: Shows label numbers for selected squares.</li>
078     *   <li>{@code SQUARE}: Shows square indices for selected squares.</li>
079     * </ul>
080     */
081    public enum NumberMode {
082        NONE,    // No numbers are drawn on squares.
083        LABEL,   // Draws label numbers on selected squares.
084        SQUARE   // Draws square numbers on selected squares.
085    }
086
087    private NumberMode numberMode = NumberMode.NONE;
088
089    /**
090     * Predefined, consistent colors for assigned cell IDs.
091     */
092    private static final Color[] CELL_COLORS = {
093            Color.RED,
094            Color.GREEN,
095            Color.BLUE,
096            Color.MAGENTA,
097            Color.ORANGE,
098            Color.CYAN
099    };
100
101    private JWindow infoPopup;
102
103    /**
104     * Constructs a {@code SquareGridPanel} with the specified grid size and sets
105     * up mouse listeners for interaction (selection and popups).
106     *
107     * @param rows number of grid rows
108     * @param cols number of grid columns
109     */
110    public SquareGridPanel(int rows, int cols) {
111        this.rows = rows;
112        this.cols = cols;
113
114        setPreferredSize(new Dimension(NUMBER_PIXELS_WIDTH, NUMBER_PIXELS_HEIGHT));
115
116        // --- Mouse listener for selection and info popups ---
117        addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
118
119            @Override
120            public void mousePressed(MouseEvent e) {
121
122                // Right press: hide popup immediately (more reliable than mouseClicked)
123                if (SwingUtilities.isRightMouseButton(e)) {
124                    hideInfoPopup();
125                    return;
126                }
127
128                if (!selectionEnabled) {
129                    return;
130                }
131
132                dragStart = e.getPoint();
133                selectionRect = new Rectangle(dragStart);
134            }
135
136            @Override
137            public void mouseReleased(MouseEvent e) {
138                if (!selectionEnabled) {
139                    return;
140                }
141                if (selectionRect != null) {
142                    selectSquaresInRect(selectionRect);
143                    selectionRect = null;
144                    SquareGridPanel.this.repaint();
145                }
146            }
147
148            @Override
149            public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent e) {
150
151                int squareW = getWidth() / cols;
152                int squareH = getHeight() / rows;
153                int col     = e.getX() / squareW;
154                int row     = e.getY() / squareH;
155
156                // Selection mode: toggle selection
157                if (selectionEnabled) {
158                    Square square = findSquareAt(row, col);
159                    if (square != null) {
160
161                        if (!square.isVisible()) {
162                            Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
163                            return;
164                        }
165
166                        int sqNum = square.getSquareNumber();
167                        if (selectedSquaresNumbers.contains(sqNum)) {
168                            selectedSquaresNumbers.remove(sqNum);
169                        } else {
170                            selectedSquaresNumbers.add(sqNum);
171                        }
172
173                        SquareGridPanel.this.repaint();
174                    }
175                    return;
176                }
177
178                // Normal viewer mode: show info on LEFT click (keep here, but it will now be much more reliable)
179                if (SwingUtilities.isLeftMouseButton(e) && infoPopupsEnabled) {
180                    showSquareInfo(e.getX(), e.getY());
181                }
182            }
183        });
184
185
186
187        // --- Mouse motion listener for drag-selection ---
188        addMouseMotionListener(new MouseMotionAdapter() {
189            @Override
190            public void mouseDragged(MouseEvent e) {
191                if (!selectionEnabled) {
192                    return;
193                }
194                int x = Math.min(dragStart.x, e.getX());
195                int y = Math.min(dragStart.y, e.getY());
196                int w = Math.abs(dragStart.x - e.getX());
197                int h = Math.abs(dragStart.y - e.getY());
198                selectionRect = new Rectangle(x, y, w, h);
199                SquareGridPanel.this.repaint();
200            }
201        });
202    }
203
204    /**
205     * Displays an informational popup for the square under the given coordinates.
206     *
207     * @param mouseX x-coordinate of the mouse
208     * @param mouseY y-coordinate of the mouse
209     */
210    private void showSquareInfo(int mouseX, int mouseY) {
211        if (!infoPopupsEnabled) {
212            return;
213        }
214
215        if (squares == null || squares.isEmpty()) {
216            return;
217        }
218
219        int squareW = getWidth() / cols;
220        int squareH = getHeight() / rows;
221        int row     = mouseY / squareH;
222        int col     = mouseX / squareW;
223
224        Square square = findSquareAt(row, col);
225        if (square == null) {
226            return;
227        }
228        int    trackCount = square.getNumberOfTracks();
229
230        // With a 1x1 grid the single square is the whole recording, so its Tau is the
231        // whole-screen Tau. It is read from Squares.csv; no tracks are needed.
232        String tauRow = (rows == 1 && cols == 1)
233                ? String.format("<tr><td>Tau:</td><td align='right'>%.0f ms</td></tr>", square.getTau())
234                : "";
235
236        String html = String.format(
237                "<html><body style='font-family:sans-serif;font-size:11px;'>"
238                        + "<b>Square %d</b>"
239                        + "<table style='margin-top:4px;'>"
240                        + "<tr><td style='padding-right:8px;'>Density:</td><td align='right'>%.4f</td></tr>"
241                        + "<tr><td style='padding-right:8px;'>Density Ratio:</td><td align='right'>%.1f</td></tr>"
242                        + "<tr><td>Variability:</td><td align='right'>%.1f</td></tr>"
243                        + "%s"
244                        + "<tr><td>R²:</td><td align='right'>%.2f</td></tr>"
245                        + "<tr><td>Tracks:</td><td align='right'>%d</td></tr>"
246                        + "</table>"
247                        + "<div style='margin-top:4px; font-style:italic; color:#666;'>"
248                        + "Right-click anywhere to close"
249                        + "</div>"
250                        + "</body></html>",
251                square.getSquareNumber(),
252                square.getDensity(),
253                square.getDensityRatio(),
254                square.getVariability(),
255                tauRow,
256                square.getRSquared(),
257                trackCount
258        );
259
260        if (infoPopup == null) {
261            infoPopup = new JWindow(SwingUtilities.getWindowAncestor(this));
262            JLabel label = new JLabel(html);
263            label.setOpaque(true);
264            label.setBackground(new Color(255, 255, 255, 230));
265            label.setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
266                    BorderFactory.createLineBorder(Color.DARK_GRAY),
267                    BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(6, 8, 6, 8)
268            ));
269            infoPopup.add(label);
270            infoPopup.pack();
271            infoPopup.setAlwaysOnTop(true);
272        } else {
273            ((JLabel) infoPopup.getContentPane().getComponent(0)).setText(html);
274        }
275
276        Point panelScreen = getLocationOnScreen();
277        int popupX = panelScreen.x + col * squareW + squareW + 8;
278        int popupY = panelScreen.y + row * squareH + squareH / 4;
279
280        Rectangle screen = GraphicsEnvironment.getLocalGraphicsEnvironment().getMaximumWindowBounds();
281        if (popupX + infoPopup.getWidth() > screen.x + screen.width) {
282            popupX = panelScreen.x + col * squareW - infoPopup.getWidth() - 8;
283        }
284        if (popupY + infoPopup.getHeight() > screen.y + screen.height) {
285            popupY = screen.y + screen.height - infoPopup.getHeight() - 8;
286        }
287
288        infoPopup.setLocation(popupX, popupY);
289        infoPopup.setVisible(true);
290    }
291
292    /**
293     * Hides and disposes the info popup if currently visible.
294     */
295    private void hideInfoPopup() {
296        if (infoPopup != null) {
297            infoPopup.setVisible(false);
298            infoPopup.dispose();
299            infoPopup = null;
300        }
301    }
302
303    /**
304     * Selects all squares that intersect the specified rectangle.
305     *
306     * @param rect selection area in panel coordinates
307     */
308    private void selectSquaresInRect(Rectangle rect) {
309        int squareW = getWidth() / cols;
310        int squareH = getHeight() / rows;
311
312        dragSelectedSquares.clear();
313
314        for (Square square : squares) {
315            Rectangle r = new Rectangle(
316                    square.getColNumber() * squareW,
317                    square.getRowNumber() * squareH,
318                    squareW, squareH
319            );
320
321            // 🔹 Only add squares that are visible
322            if (rect.intersects(r) && square.isVisible()) {
323                selectedSquaresNumbers.add(square.getSquareNumber());
324                dragSelectedSquares.add(square.getSquareNumber());
325            }
326        }
327
328        this.repaint();
329    }

376    /**
377     * Paints all visual elements including the grid, overlays, and selections.
378     */
379    @Override
380    protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
381        super.paintComponent(g);
382
383        if (backgroundImage != null) {
384            g.drawImage(backgroundImage, 0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight(), this);
385        }
386        if (squares == null) {
387            return;
388        }
389
390        int        squareW = getWidth() / cols;
391        int        squareH = getHeight() / rows;
392        Graphics2D g2      = (Graphics2D) g;
393
394        // --- Draw cells, overlays, and borders ---
395        for (Square square : squares) {
396            int x = square.getColNumber() * squareW;
397            int y = square.getRowNumber() * squareH;
398
399            boolean visible      = square.isVisible(); // selected == visible (from filter)
400            boolean userSelected = selectedSquaresNumbers.contains(square.getSquareNumber());
401            boolean hasCell      = square.getCellId() > 0;
402
403            // --- Base fill ---
404            if (!visible) {
405                // Filtered-out squares: subtle gray fill + faint border
406                g2.setColor(new Color(0, 0, 0, 20));
407                g2.fillRect(x, y, squareW, squareH);
408
409                if (showBorders) {
410                    g2.setStroke(new BasicStroke(0.5f));
411                    g2.setColor(new Color(255, 255, 255, 25));
412                    g2.drawRect(x, y, squareW, squareH);
413                }
414                continue;
415            }
416
417            // --- Visible squares ---
418            if (showShading) {
419                // Assigned cell color base layer
420                if (hasCell) {
421                    Color baseColor = getColorForCell(square.getCellId());
422                    g2.setColor(new Color(baseColor.getRed(), baseColor.getGreen(), baseColor.getBlue(), 100));
423                    g2.fillRect(x, y, squareW, squareH);
424                }
425
426                // Yellow user-selection overlay
427                if (userSelected) {
428                    g2.setColor(new Color(255, 235, 0, 180));
429                    g2.fillRect(x, y, squareW, squareH);
430                }
431
432                // Light white tint for visible but not selected/assigned
433                if (!userSelected && !hasCell) {
434                    g2.setColor(new Color(255, 255, 255, 50));
435                    g2.fillRect(x, y, squareW, squareH);
436                }
437            }
438
439            // --- Borders for all visible squares ---
440            if (showBorders) {
441                g2.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1.0f));
442                g2.setColor(new Color(255, 255, 255, 150)); // soft white
443                g2.drawRect(x, y, squareW, squareH);
444            }
445        }
446
447        // --- Draw numbers inside selected squares ---
448        for (Square square : squares) {
449            if (square.isVisible()) {
450                int x = square.getColNumber() * squareW;
451                int y = square.getRowNumber() * squareH;
452                if (numberMode == NumberMode.LABEL) {
453                    drawCenteredString(g2, String.valueOf(square.getLabelNumber()), x, y, squareW, squareH);
454                } else if (numberMode == NumberMode.SQUARE) {
455                    drawCenteredString(g2, String.valueOf(square.getSquareNumber()), x, y, squareW, squareH);
456                }
457            }
458        }
459
460        // --- Draw drag-selection rectangle ---
461        if (selectionRect != null && selectionEnabled) {
462            g2.setColor(new Color(255, 255, 180, 100));
463            g2.fill(selectionRect);
464            g2.setColor(Color.BLACK);
465            g2.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1.5f));
466            g2.draw(selectionRect);
467        }
468    }
469
470    /**
471     * Draws centered text inside a given square.
472     */
473    private void drawCenteredString(Graphics g, String text, int x, int y, int w, int h) {
474        Font original = g.getFont();
475        Font small    = original.deriveFont(original.getSize2D() * 0.8f);
476        g.setFont(small);
477
478        FontMetrics fm = g.getFontMetrics();
479        int         tx = x + (w - fm.stringWidth(text)) / 2;
480        int         ty = y + (h + fm.getAscent() - fm.getDescent()) / 2;
481        g.setColor(Color.WHITE);
482        g.drawString(text, tx, ty);
483        g.setFont(original);
484    }

502    /**

505    public static int getSupportedCellCount() {
506        return CELL_COLORS.length;
507    }
508
509    /**
510     * Returns the consistent color associated with a specific cell ID.
511     */
512    public static Color getColorForCell(int cellId) {
513        if (cellId <= 0) {
514            return Color.GRAY;
515        }
516        return CELL_COLORS[(cellId - 1) % CELL_COLORS.length];
517    }

519    /**
520     * Updates visibility control parameters for the panel.
521     */
522    public void setControlParameters(double minRequiredDensityRatio,
523                                     double maxAllowableVariability,
524                                     double minRequiredRSquared,
525                                     String neighbourMode) {
526        this.minRequiredDensityRatio = minRequiredDensityRatio;
527        this.maxAllowableVariability = maxAllowableVariability;
528        this.minRequiredRSquared     = minRequiredRSquared;
529        this.neighbourMode           = (neighbourMode != null) ? neighbourMode : "Free";
530    }

532    /**
533     * Applies the active visibility filter using {@link SharedSquareUtils}.
534     */
535    public void applyVisibilityFilter() {
536        SharedSquareUtils.applyVisibilityFilter(
537                squares,
538                minRequiredDensityRatio,
539                maxAllowableVariability,
540                minRequiredRSquared,
541                neighbourMode);
542        this.repaint();
543    }

608            hideSquareInfoIfVisible();

612
613    private Square findSquareAt(int row, int col) {
614        if (squares == null) {
615            return null;
616        }
617        for (Square sq : squares) {
618            if (sq.getRowNumber() == row && sq.getColNumber() == col) {
619                return sq;
620            }
621        }
622        return null;
623    }
624}
